_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `s.raster.raster` is a LAYERED DOCUMENT, not an image file: its pixels live behind ids in a root `assets` pool and the vocabulary edits the layer tree around them, so a raster codec is a reader of a different artifact. The reference is a SECOND IMPLEMENTATION in Python written from this subset's committed mutation schema, grammar and specification vectors.

oracles.rationale: A second implementation of the `s.raster.raster` layered document and all twelve typed mutations, in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-raster-1/🐍️component.py`. Written from `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🔣️component.json` (all twelve variants, their internally tagged wire form and each one's required members), `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/📝️text/📖️component.grammar.semio` (the twelve verbs and their positional argument lists) and the twelve committed `(before, mutation, after, outcome)` specification vectors. It imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust. A third-party library was declined, not merely absent: `png`, `image` and `tiff` read image FILES and this artifact is a layer tree over an id-keyed asset pool; Pillow reads the pixel payloads and has no authority over a group's `children`, a blend mode, or a reorder that lifts a node out of a group. What a reference can adjudicate is the tree algebra, and that is what this one implements. DEFECT FOUND WHILE WRITING IT, reported rather than worked around: `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️component.json` does not describe this artifact — it is a verbatim copy of `s.stdio.json`'s `JsonSnapshot` schema with the wrong `$id`, so the mutation schema's `RasterLayerNode` reference points at nothing; the document shape was read off the twelve committed vectors, which agree with one another on every field. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.
